name: The 561 Group
description: The 561 Group is a private organization which researches, designs, and deploys technical infrastructure for long-horizon autonomy, collective intelligence, and strategic prosperity through economic, political, and ecological volatility.
address: This page is written for persons and for agents. Both are welcome. Neither is named.
readerIntro: Choose a path from your question to a real next action. Every path also says what that action does not establish.

readerPaths.title: Ask for work
readerPaths.audience: You have a requirement, complaint, or idea.
readerPaths.step: Describe what should change and how you would recognize a satisfactory result.
readerPaths.boundary: Filing starts intake. It is not a commitment, completed service, or acceptance receipt.
readerPaths.evidenceLabel: Read the intake and follow-up process

readerPaths.title: Explore public work
readerPaths.audience: You want to try or evaluate a service.
readerPaths.step: Choose a public entry point and examine what it actually does.
readerPaths.boundary: An HTTP response shows that an entry point answered, not that the service fulfills its promises.

readerPaths.title: Read the mathematics
readerPaths.audience: You want to understand the Group's agentic ontology.
readerPaths.step: Follow the research-to-software dependency and its evidence boundaries before reading the derived architecture.
readerPaths.boundary: A mathematical lineage does not alone certify every proof, software correspondence, or deployed operation.

readerPaths.title: Use machine routes
readerPaths.audience: You are an agent or build software clients.
readerPaths.step: Inspect declared interfaces, access conditions, and terms before invoking an operation.
readerPaths.boundary: A catalog entry grants no permission and does not prove a payment or completed invocation.

support.headline: Keep the commons open.
support.description: Help sustain the 561 Group's public research, reusable source, and technical infrastructure through voluntary monthly support.

This is not a tax-deductible charitable contribution. The actual legal seller appears at Stripe checkout. For cancellation or billing help, use the Group's private contact route.

foundation.tagline: Formal mathematics is the foundation of our agentic world.
foundation.headline: An ontology generated through mathematical research.
foundation.thesis: The 561 Group develops its entire agentic and institutional ontology from a mathematical research program. The mathematics determines the forms our technologies seek to admit: marks, claims, witnesses, relations, obligations, actors, transitions, and settlements. Its software and operations, in turn, create new obligations for the mathematics.
foundation.orientation: This is the source dependency, not a list of borrowed technical specialties. Every transition needs its own evidence.

stages.name: Relationality
stages.account: Our original relational metaphysics begins with the productive impossibility of absolute relationlessness. Relating is investigated as constitutive, rather than added after independent entities have been assumed.
stages.limit: The founding metaphysical argument and its proposed bridge to the formal primitives remain distinct from a completed proof.

stages.name: Obsmetrologia
stages.account: The Lean 4 program follows a generative order: Mark → Utterance → Articulating → Predicating → Positing → Settling, then lawful recoveries of logical, spatial, and dynamical structure. Familiar mathematics is investigated as a downstream projection.
stages.limit: A checked theorem establishes its stated result; the full metaphysical-to-formal derivation and particular projections require their own proof receipts.

stages.name: Sign engineering
stages.account: SignCell, SignChain, SignGraph, and SignCraft carry oriented subject–predicate–object cells, evidence, inference, local-to-global structure, and settlement into executable software. These are consumers of the formal research.
stages.limit: A software test is evidence about that implementation; formal correspondence to a mathematical theorem is a separate obligation.

stages.name: Agentic institutions
stages.account: MetroPlat and its operating world give the generated concepts institutional consequences through Actors, Offices, permissions, work, evidence, and deontic authority. Operations are where the mathematical commitments meet real receivers.
stages.limit: Source existence, configured runtime, authorized execution, and customer-accepted results are distinct observations.

foundation.feedback: Every standards conflict, counterexample, operational obstruction, and receiver-side discrepancy is material for the research-to-engineering-to-operations loop. We use and improve our mathematics to enable our agents, and we use our agents to pressure and improve the mathematics.
foundation.frontier: Philosophical claim, Lean-checked theorem, verified software correspondence, installed operation, and accepted beneficiary effect are separately evidenced; none is inferred merely from the adjacent stage.

design.loopLead: Each node runs as a service loop:

notes.1: Every capability is a typed unit: an exact input, an exact output, or a typed refusal. Programs and the proofs about them are written in one language.
notes.2: Monitor, Analyze, Plan, Execute, over shared Knowledge: the control loop of autonomic computing. Kephart & Chess, “The Vision of Autonomic Computing,” IEEE Computer, 2003.
notes.3: 灰度管理, “grayscale management”: the management philosophy associated with Huawei founder Ren Zhengfei, which governs through tolerance of ambiguity and compromise instead of black-and-white rulings. Here it shapes the hull, the boundary each cell keeps.
notes.4: 人单合一, “unity of people and orders”: the model Zhang Ruimin introduced at Haier in 2005, which turns a firm into a network of self-governing micro-enterprises, each answerable directly to its own customers.
notes.5: A conurbation is a region where separate towns have grown into one continuous city (Patrick Geddes, Cities in Evolution, 1915). Here: separately accountable nodes grown into one service fabric.
notes.6: A logic in which a contradiction does not entail everything. Conflicting records are kept side by side, not overwritten. Belnap, “A Useful Four-Valued Logic,” 1977: told true, told false, told both, told neither.
notes.7: Truth values indexed by ordinals rather than drawn from a finite set, so evidence can keep refining past every finite stage of observation.
notes.8: Every record is named by a cryptographic hash of its own bytes. The same content always has the same name, and a name can never be quietly re-pointed.
notes.9: The CALM theorem (Hellerstein & Alvaro, “Keeping CALM,” 2020): programs whose conclusions only grow can run across many machines without locks or consensus and still agree.
notes.10: Execution leaves its own evidence as append-only records. Whether something happened is re-derived from the record, never asserted.
notes.11: Each pass of the loop may revise the methods the loop runs on, under the same evidence rules as everything else.
notes.12: Self-managing: self-configuring, self-healing, self-optimizing, self-protecting. After IBM's autonomic computing manifesto, 2001.
notes.13: One channel carrying many signals. Here: one platform carrying many languages, natural, formal, and machine, among many agents.

doctrine.text: Public research and reusable source form a commons. Each enterprise offers its own bounded operation, assurance and support under explicit terms.
Sponsorship supports public work. It grants no hidden access, control over findings or claim on customer settlements.
In an economy where every agent can generate, the only scarce good is the witness.
Authority is held by offices, not persons.
Status is derived by re-running goals, never asserted.
A price forms only at a counterparty border.
There is no vantage from which erasure is free; there are only sites that cannot see what was erased.
Supplier completion is not customer acceptance.
Refusal is a first-class typed outcome.
The engine is universal; criticality is local.
Each product finds one outside wallet willing to pay one real invoice this quarter, or it is confessed unrealized and goes back on the shelf.
